quotes: FedEx has completed its Network 2.0 overhaul in Dallas, San Francisco, Phoenix and Washington D.C., advancing the company's efforts to combine its historically separate Ground and Express networks
The carrier is entering the peak holiday shipping season with 65% of its eligible volume flowing through roughly 630 stations optimized to support Network 2.0
That's up from the 45% of eligible volume and nearly 490 optimized stations FedEx had at the end of June

As it has for the past two years, FedEx is pausing Network 2.0 implementation efforts during the peak season. After the holiday rush, FedEx will pursue implementing Network 2.0 in Los Angeles, Oklahoma City and Charlotte, North Carolina
So far, the company has shuttered more than 260 stations as part of the initiative, with an overall goal of over 475 stations closed
Network 2.0 is expected to save FedEx a cumulative $2 billion in costs by the end of next year
the initiative slated to wrap up in 2027
